tldr: Evening batch, Aug 11: Anthropic's unreleased research Claude lifts the Riemann-hypothesis lower bound from 41.6% to 67.2% — a genuine math milestone short of a proof — as the lab also locks in a $9.1B data-center deal with Bitcoin miner Riot and starts watermarking all Claude outputs globally. Nvidia guarantees its own chips' resale value to unlock $500B in AI infrastructure financing; Zuckerberg drops a 6,500-word open-source manifesto alongside Muse Glimmer 30B. Qwen3.8-27B open weights land this week with new MM-Plugins; Hermes ships Browser Use mode (48-66% token savings) and Pixel Office visualization; papers propose MatrAIx's 8.3B persona agents and SWE-Bench ProMax.

articles.title: Anthropic Research Claude Lifts Riemann Hypothesis Bound to 67.2%
articles.summary: Unreleased research Claude raised the lower bound for Riemann-zeta zeros satisfying the hypothesis from 41.6% to 67.2% — real strides, short of a proof.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-27B Open Weights Land This Week
articles.summary: Alibaba confirms Qwen3.8-27B open weights ship this week, following strong agentic-coding results from Qwen3.6-27B.

articles.title: Qwen-MM-Plugins: Multimodal-Native Agents
articles.summary: Qwen plugin suite makes any agent harness multimodal-native — read images/video/docs, edit video, work with 3D/CAD via GitHub.

articles.title: Hermes Browser Use Mode Cuts Token Use 48-66%
articles.summary: Hermes collapses 12 browser tools into one script-driven Browser Use mode (browser_use CLI 3.0) — 48-66% fewer tokens, no accuracy drop.

articles.title: Hermes Pixel Office: Live Agent Visualization on VSCode
articles.summary: Hermes Pixel Office ships on VSCode and GitHub — live visualization of all running Hermes agents via the Hermes Agent Plugin.

articles.title: Teknium Publishes Locked-Down Hermes Starter Profile
articles.summary: Teknium publishes hermes-starter-profile: a security-hardened Hermes setup with nearly all tools disabled for safe deployments.

articles.title: MatrAIx: Simulating the World with 8.3B Persona Agents
articles.summary: New paper proposes MatrAIx — simulating the world with 8.3 billion persona agents.

articles.title: SWE-Bench ProMax: Multilingual Code Refactoring Benchmark
articles.summary: SWE-Bench ProMax benchmarks coding agents on large-scale multilingual code refactoring.

articles.title: Anthropic: Claude Largely Resists Prompt Injection Now
articles.summary: Anthropic's Boris Cherny: Claude now largely resists prompt injection in practice, per independent benchmark — hopes other labs follow.

articles.title: Anthropic Signs $9.1B Data Center Deal with Riot Platforms
articles.summary: Anthropic leases $9.1B of data-center capacity from Bitcoin miner Riot at its Texas Rockdale site; options could push total to $16.1B.

articles.title: Nvidia Guarantees Chip Value to Unlock $500B AI Infrastructure Financing
articles.summary: Nvidia guarantees its chips' resale value to unlock $500B in AI infrastructure financing — de-risking hyperscale buildouts.

articles.title: Anthropic Watermarks All Claude Outputs Globally
articles.summary: Anthropic now watermarks all Claude outputs globally with marks that may persist through some editing.

articles.title: Zuckerberg Drops 6,500-Word AI Manifesto, Open-Sources Muse Glimmer 30B
articles.summary: Zuckerberg's manifesto pushes open-weight releases and government safety collaboration; Meta open-sources Muse Glimmer 30B alongside.

articles.title: Show HN: Ante — Offline Coding Agent in a Single Binary
articles.summary: Ante is a coding agent in a single binary that runs fully offline — no cloud needed. 135 points on Hacker News.

articles.title: Coding Test: BF16 Muse Glimmer vs BF16 Qwen3.6 27B
articles.summary: LocalLLaMA coding test: BF16 Muse Glimmer vs Qwen3.6 27B at full FP16 KV-cache — Glimmer runs full 262K context, Qwen capped at 147.5K.
